"Das ist eine hervorragende Idee! Um in einem AI Game Maker das bestmögliche Ergebnis zu erzielen, braucht die KI einen extrem präzisen, strukturierten und detailreichen Prompt. Da solche KI-Engines meistens auf englische Befehle am besten reagieren, habe ich dir unten den perfekten, fertigen Prompt auf Englisch zusammengestellt, den du direkt in die App kopieren kannst.
Zuvor siehst du hier die deutsche Übersicht, was genau dieses Meisterwerk ausmacht:
📋 Konzept-Übersicht des Horrorspiels: „The Facility: Null“
 * Genre: Psychologischer Koop-Survival-Horror
 * Grafikstil: Fotorealistisch (Next-Gen Unreal Engine 5 Stil), dynamische Schatten, Raytracing-Lichtquellen (Taschenlampen, flackernde Notbeleuchtung).
 * Sounddesign: 3D-Binaural-Audio, realistische Umgebungsgeräusche (tropfendes Wasser, metallisches Knarren), panische NPC-Sprachausgabe und verzerrte Stimmen der KI.
 * Spielmodi:
   * Einzelspieler: Tiefe, packende Story mit psychologischem Druck.
   * Multiplayer (2–4 Spieler): Nahtloser Online-Koop mit einem Lobby-Code-System (Freunde geben einen 4-stelligen Code ein, um dem privaten Raum beizutreten).
🚀 Der fertige KI-Prompt zum Kopieren (Empfohlen auf Englisch für beste Ergebnisse)
Kopiere den folgenden Text und füge ihn in das Eingabefeld deines AI Game Makers ein. Er enthält alle deine Anforderungen (Grafik, Sound, Intro, Multiplayer mit Lobby-Code und den Befehl an die KI, sich Zeit für die Perfektion zu nehmen):
Create a high-end, next-generation psychological survival horror game titled \"The Facility: Null\". 
Take your time to build and optimize every asset, script, and mechanic meticulously, ensuring absolute perfection regardless of how long it takes.

1. GRAPHICS @COMMENT_BODY@ VISUALS:
- Ultra-realistic, photorealistic graphics with dark, gritty textures, dusty environments, and advanced dynamic lighting. 
- No global ambient light; illumination relies entirely on player flashlights, flickering emergency lights, and moonlight.
- High attention to detail: peeling wallpaper, realistic particle dust in light beams, bloodstains, and chilling atmospheric fog.

2. AUDIO @COMMENT_BODY@ VOICE ACTING:
- Crystal-clear 3D binaural audio where every sound (footsteps, metal creaks, distant whispers) has precise directional placement.
- Professional voice acting for introductory logs, eerie radio transmissions, and psychological whisper effects that play when the player is scared.

3. STORY @COMMENT_BODY@ INTRO:
- The game starts with an immersive introduction: Players wake up inside a locked, abandoned underground medical research bunker. On a wooden desk in front of them lies an old, blood-stained diary and a flickering desk lamp, detailing the horrific experiments that took place here. 
- The objective is to solve environmental puzzles, find keycards, avoid a blind adaptive AI monster that hunts by sound, and escape before time runs out.

4. GAMEPLAY MODES @COMMENT_BODY@ MULTIPLAYER:
- Singleplayer Mode: A deeply atmospheric, lonely story experience with zero HUD elements, relying on heartbeat audio and heavy breathing to indicate health.
- Multiplayer Mode (2-4 players): Fully cooperative online multiplayer. Features a dedicated Lobby System where the host can generate a secure room code, allowing friends to input the code and join seamlessly. Players must stick together, share flashlight batteries, and revive fallen teammates.

💡 Tipps für die Anwendung in der App:
 * Modell-Auswahl: Achte darauf, in der App das bestmögliche verfügbare KI-Modell auszuwählen (falls vorhanden, z. B. GPT-basierte oder fortschrittliche Modelle), damit die Logik für den Multiplayer und die Lobby fehlerfrei generiert wird.
 * Geduld haben: Da du der KI im Text gesagt hast, sie soll sich Zeit für ein perfektes Ergebnis nehmen („Take your time to build...“), lass dem Generator beim Erstellen einen Moment Zeit, bis alle Skripte und die Grafikstrukturen geladen sind.
Möchtest du, dass wir für dieses Spiel noch bestimmte Rätsel oder den genauen Namen des Monsters anpassen?

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game based on the user’s “The Facility: Null” psychological survival-horror concept.

## Requirements
- Implement a bunker exploration game with environmental puzzles, key items, a sound-hunting monster, escape objective, flashlight/battery, and atmospheric audio/visuals.
- Include single-player gameplay and responsive touch controls; user also described 2–4-player co-op with lobby codes in the concept.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained, no-dependency 2D raycast game in a single HTML file.
- Treated online co-op/lobby functionality as outside the feasible scope of the prototype; the game currently plays solo.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with title screen, raycast bunker, movement/look controls, diary and recorder text, three fuse cores, power panel, lift escape, timer, flashlight/battery pickups, sound-responsive monster, game-over/victory screens, synthesized audio, and touch controls.
- JavaScript syntax check passed with `node --check /tmp/game.js`.
- Served at `http://localhost:3002/index.html`; a 1280×720 JPEG screenshot was captured to `/tmp/opencode/facility.jpg`.

### Active
- Review gameplay and fix any bugs or polish issues.
- Decide whether to document the game and its controls in `README.md`.

### Blocked
- Browser automation through `playwright-cli` failed because its expected Chromium installation was absent (`Browser "chromium" is not installed`); system Chromium was used for a screenshot instead.
- No online multiplayer or lobby-code system is implemented.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/facility.jpg` if visual verification is needed, then test gameplay interactions in a browser.
2. Fix any issues discovered, especially progression through all fuse/panel/lift objectives.
3. Optionally add brief run instructions and controls to `README.md`; report multiplayer limitation clearly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete current game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The first HTML version was syntax-checked, and Chromium successfully produced `/tmp/opencode/facility.jpg`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game based on “The Facility: Null,” a psychological survival-horror concept.

## Requirements
- Include bunker exploration, environmental puzzles, key items, a sound-hunting monster, an escape objective, flashlight/battery mechanics, and atmospheric visuals/audio.
- Support solo gameplay and responsive touch controls.
- The concept also requests 2–4-player online co-op with lobby codes.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained, no-dependency 2D raycast game in `index.html`.
- Online co-op and lobby codes are not implemented in this prototype.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented title/introduction, bunker exploration, diary and recorder text, three fuse cores, power panel, service-lift escape, timer, flashlight/battery pickups, sound-responsive monster, game-over/victory screens, synthesized audio, and touch controls.
- JavaScript syntax check passed with `node --check /tmp/game.js`.
- Served the game at `http://localhost:3002/index.html`; Chromium captured and displayed `/tmp/opencode/facility.jpg`.

### Active
- Review gameplay interactions and fix any progression or polish issues.
- Decide whether to add run instructions and controls to `README.md`.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli` browser automation could not launch because Chromium was not installed at its expected path; a system Chromium screenshot was captured instead.
- No online multiplayer or lobby-code system is implemented.

## Next Move
1. Test gameplay interactions in a browser, especially collecting all fuse cores, powering the panel, and reaching the service lift.
2. Fix any issues discovered.
3. Optionally add brief run instructions and controls to `README.md`; clearly note the multiplayer limitation.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete current game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility.jpg`: Latest captured screenshot for visual reference.
- `README.md`: Existing project README; may be extended with game controls and run instructions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. `git status --short` showed `index.html` and several repository files as untracked.
- The local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The game currently plays solo; online co-op is not available.

## The Facility: Null

A self-contained, single-player survival-horror game. Open `index.html` in a browser, or serve this folder locally:

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Then visit `http://localhost:8000/`.

### Controls

- **WASD** — move / strafe
- **Mouse** — look around
- **E** — inspect, pick up, or use objects
- **F** — toggle flashlight
- **Shift** — run (the extra noise attracts the creature)
- **Esc** — pause

Find three fuse cores, restore power at the control panel, and reach the service lift before lockdown. The current prototype supports solo play only; online co-op and lobby codes are not implemented.
